inputs.v1.1: v1.0 data/processed snapshots at 7886867 and data/kept/T16-T19 raw cache

decisions: T21: the 12 holding months are measured between consecutive decision dates (the twelve months to t, settlements up to and including t), from the chained F1 and F2 indices
The 10% single-market risk cap of section 2.4 (a sleeve-construction convention) is applied to all three sleeves, measured with each sleeve's own sigma

Combination timing: the scale s_t and the gross cap are set at month-end t from v1.1's held weights and the sleeve's weights held after its rebalance in month t; the sleeve leg earns kappa_t = 0.25 s_t (capped) times the sleeve's net return in month t+1 (positions decided at month-end earn next month, as v1.1's FX legs); a change of kappa is a trade of |dkappa| x the sleeve's held notional, charged at its cost rates

Clark-West: target = the market's F1 holding-period excess return from this execution to the next; the prevailing mean and the pooled slope use pairs with s < t as pre-registered (holding periods of earlier rebalance months, first forecast at the 2010-01 decision); beta_t = OLS slope of r on z with an intercept; z = cross-sectional ranks standardised to mean 0, SD 1, winsorised at +-2
